entries.40a91a616587c1bd: A company engaged in home-visit nursing, in which nurses and others visit users' homes to provide nursing care, and in placement of medical professionals.
entries.4a4aadf8cef18661: A business in which nurses, assistant nurses, physical therapists, occupational therapists and speech-language-hearing therapists visit users’ homes and other locations based on instructions from their attending physicians to provide medical treatment and rehabilitation.
entries.4c14d3be58516aa7: A company headquartered in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, that operates a visiting nursing service business and a paramedical staffing agency business. It has 1 consolidated subsidiary, RePath Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,689 million, and it had 349 employees as of December 31, 2025.
entries.4e48f7839282dc25: A fee-charging employment placement business in which consolidated subsidiary RePath Co., Ltd. matches job seekers such as nurses and rehabilitation professionals with job openings at medical institutions such as hospitals and nursing care facilities. It operates the job-seeker registration site “Rīpasu Nurse,” and revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥92 million.

entries.9817c6fa8f15c50d: A business in which nurses, assistant nurses, physical therapists, occupational therapists and speech-language-hearing therapists visit users’ homes and other locations based on instructions from their attending physicians to provide medical treatment and rehabilitation. Payment is received from insurers and users under the medical insurance and long-term care insurance systems. It operates 5 visiting nursing station sites and 31 satellite sites, and revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,597 million.
